Benchmark corpus for securock sast. Each case is a complete Go file after a "=== name"
line. The first comment of a case states the expected outcome:

  // want: RULE[, RULE]   these rules must be reported, and no others
  // want: none           nothing may be reported
  // gap: RULE            a real vulnerability the engine does not find yet (false negative)
  // fp-gap: RULE         safe code the engine wrongly reports today (false positive)

A gap or fp-gap case fails once the engine handles it, so the file must be promoted to
want and the numbers stay honest. The corpus is written by the engine's authors: it guards
against regressions and documents limits, it is not a measure of real-world accuracy.

=== sqli-concat
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = " + r.FormValue("id"))
}

=== sqli-sprintf-variable
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.URL.Query().Get("id")
	q := fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = '%s'", id)
	db.Exec(q)
}

=== sqli-context-variant
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	db.QueryRowContext(r.Context(), "SELECT 1 WHERE n = '"+r.FormValue("n")+"'")
}

=== sqli-transaction
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(tx *sql.Tx, r *http.Request) {
	tx.Exec("DELETE FROM t WHERE k = " + r.PostFormValue("k"))
}

=== sqli-repository-method
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type repo struct{ db *sql.DB }

func (r *repo) find(name string) {
	r.db.Query("SELECT * FROM u WHERE n = '" + name + "'")
}

func h(rp *repo, r *http.Request) {
	rp.find(r.FormValue("n"))
}

=== sqli-three-calls-deep
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func a(db *sql.DB, s string) { b(db, s) }
func b(db *sql.DB, s string) { c(db, s) }
func c(db *sql.DB, s string) { db.Query("SELECT " + s) }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) { a(db, r.FormValue("x")) }

=== sqli-helper-returns-input
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func param(r *http.Request) string { return r.FormValue("n") }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) { db.Query("SELECT " + param(r)) }

=== sqli-multiple-returns
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func read(r *http.Request) (string, error) { return r.FormValue("n"), nil }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	n, err := read(r)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	db.Query("SELECT " + n)
}

=== sqli-string-methods
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	n := strings.ToUpper(strings.TrimSpace(r.FormValue("n")))
	db.Query("SELECT '" + strings.ReplaceAll(n, "x", "y") + "'")
}

=== sqli-strings-builder
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	var b strings.Builder
	b.WriteString("SELECT * FROM t WHERE n = '")
	b.WriteString(r.FormValue("n"))
	b.WriteString("'")
	db.Query(b.String())
}

=== sqli-join-slice
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	parts := []string{"a = 1"}
	parts = append(parts, "b = '"+r.FormValue("b")+"'")
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE " + strings.Join(parts, " AND "))
}

=== sqli-json-body
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
)

type in struct{ Name string }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	var v in
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&v)
	db.Query("SELECT " + v.Name)
}

=== sqli-closure-handler
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func main() {
	var db *sql.DB
	http.HandleFunc("/", func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		db.Query("SELECT " + r.FormValue("c"))
	})
}

=== sqli-range-over-values
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	r.ParseForm()
	for _, v := range r.Form["id"] {
		db.Query("SELECT " + v)
	}
}

=== sqli-branch-merge
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request, ok bool) {
	s := "SELECT 1"
	if ok {
		s = "SELECT " + r.FormValue("c")
	}
	db.Query(s)
}

=== sqli-defer-and-go
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	id := r.FormValue("id")
	go func() {
		db.Exec("DELETE FROM t WHERE id = " + id)
	}()
}

=== sqli-recursion
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func walk(db *sql.DB, s string, n int) {
	if n == 0 {
		db.Query("SELECT " + s)
		return
	}
	walk(db, s, n-1)
}

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) { walk(db, r.FormValue("x"), 3) }

=== cmd-json-body

package main

	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"os/exec"
)

type job struct{ Cmd string }

func h(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var j job
	json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&j)
	exec.Command(j.Cmd).Run()
}

	b, _ := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("/srv", r.FormValue("f")))
	w.Write(b)
}

=== multiple-rules-one-file
// want: sast:go/command-injection, sast:go/sql-injection
package main

	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"os/exec"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	db.Query("SELECT " + r.FormValue("a"))
	exec.Command("sh", "-c", r.FormValue("b")).Run()
}

// want: sast:go/weak-crypto

=== safe-atoi
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	id, err := strconv.Atoi(r.FormValue("id"))
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	db.Query(fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM t WHERE id = %d", id))
}

=== safe-constant-query
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	_ = r.FormValue("unused")
	db.Query("SELECT 1")
}

=== safe-allowlist-switch
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	var col string
	switch r.FormValue("sort") {
	case "name":
		col = "name"
	case "age":
		col = "age"
	default:
		col = "id"
	}
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY " + col)
}

=== safe-length-only

	"database/sql"

)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	n := len(r.FormValue("x"))
	db.Query(fmt.Sprintf("SELECT * FROM t LIMIT %d", n))
}

=== safe-both-branches-overwrite
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request, ok bool) {
	s := r.FormValue("c")
	if ok {
		s = "SELECT 1"
	} else {
		s = "SELECT 2"
	}
	db.Query(s)
}

=== safe-struct-fields-separate
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type q struct{ a, b string }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	var v q
	v.a = r.FormValue("x")
	v.b = "constant"
	db.Query(v.b)
}

=== safe-helper-only-called-with-constants
// want: none
package main

import "database/sql"

func find(db *sql.DB, name string) { db.Query("SELECT * FROM u WHERE n = '" + name + "'") }

func h(db *sql.DB) { find(db, "admin") }

=== safe-digest-as-filename
// want: none
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func h(r *http.Request) {
	sum := sha256.Sum256([]byte(r.FormValue("k")))
	os.ReadFile(filepath.Join("/cache", hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])))
}

	"net"
	"net/http"
)

}

=== sqli-interface-dispatch
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type store interface{ Find(name string) }

type sqlStore struct{ db *sql.DB }

func (s sqlStore) Find(name string) { s.db.Query("SELECT '" + name + "'") }

func h(s store, r *http.Request) { s.Find(r.FormValue("n")) }

=== sqli-global-variable
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

var last string

func set(r *http.Request) { last = r.FormValue("n") }

func use(db *sql.DB) { db.Query("SELECT '" + last + "'") }

=== sqli-receiver-state
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type job struct {
	db   *sql.DB
	name string
}

func (j *job) run() { j.db.Query("SELECT '" + j.name + "'") }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	j := &job{db: db}
	j.name = r.FormValue("n")
	j.run()
}

=== gap-channel
// gap: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	ch := make(chan string, 1)
	ch <- r.FormValue("n")
	db.Query("SELECT '" + <-ch + "'")
}

=== safe-allowlist-guard
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

var allowed = map[string]bool{"name": true, "age": true}

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	col := r.FormValue("sort")
	if !allowed[col] {
		return
	}
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY " + col)
}

=== safe-regexp-guard
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"regexp"
)

var ident = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z_]+$`)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	col := r.FormValue("col")
	if !ident.MatchString(col) {
		return
	}
	db.Query("SELECT " + col + " FROM t")
}

=== safe-prefix-guard-after-join
// want: none
package main

import (
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func h(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	p := filepath.Join("/srv", r.FormValue("f"))
	if !strings.HasPrefix(p, "/srv/") {
		return
	}
	os.ReadFile(p)
}

=== safe-allowlist-comma-ok
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

var columns = map[string]string{"name": "name", "age": "age"}

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	col := r.FormValue("sort")
	if _, ok := columns[col]; !ok {
		return
	}
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY " + col)
}

=== safe-allowlist-positive-form
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

var allowed = map[string]bool{"name": true}

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	col := r.FormValue("sort")
	if allowed[col] {
		db.Query("SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY " + col)
	}
}

=== safe-slices-contains-guard
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"slices"
)

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	col := r.FormValue("sort")
	if !slices.Contains([]string{"a", "b"}, col) {
		http.Error(nil, "bad", 400)
		return
	}
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY " + col)
}

=== guard-that-does-not-stop-is-not-trusted
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"log"
	"net/http"
)

var allowed = map[string]bool{"name": true}

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	col := r.FormValue("sort")
	if !allowed[col] {
		log.Println("unexpected column")
	}
	db.Query("SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY " + col)
}

=== guard-on-a-different-value

=== regexp-guard-with-wildcard-is-not-trusted

=== sqli-interface-two-implementations-one-unsafe
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type store interface{ Find(name string) }

type safe struct{ db *sql.DB }

func (s safe) Find(name string) { s.db.Query("SELECT 1 WHERE n = ?", name) }

type unsafe struct{ db *sql.DB }

func (s unsafe) Find(name string) { s.db.Query("SELECT 1 WHERE n = '" + name + "'") }

func h(s store, r *http.Request) { s.Find(r.FormValue("n")) }

=== safe-interface-all-implementations-safe
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type store interface{ Find(name string) }

type safe struct{ db *sql.DB }

func (s safe) Find(name string) { s.db.Query("SELECT 1 WHERE n = ?", name) }

func h(s store, r *http.Request) { s.Find(r.FormValue("n")) }

=== safe-method-with-untainted-receiver
// want: none
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type repo struct {
	db    *sql.DB
	table string
}

func (r *repo) all() { r.db.Query("SELECT * FROM " + r.table) }

func h(rp *repo, r *http.Request) {
	_ = r.FormValue("ignored")
	rp.all()
}

=== fp-gap-receiver-other-field
// fp-gap: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

import (
	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
)

type job struct {
	db    *sql.DB
	table string
	note  string
}

func (j *job) run() { j.db.Query("SELECT * FROM " + j.table) }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) {
	j := &job{db: db, table: "users"}
	j.note = r.FormValue("n")
	j.run()
}

=== sqli-variadic-helper
// want: sast:go/sql-injection
package main

	"database/sql"
	"net/http"
	"strings"
)

func where(db *sql.DB, conds ...string) { db.Query("SELECT * FROM t WHERE " + strings.Join(conds, " AND ")) }

func h(db *sql.DB, r *http.Request) { where(db, "a = 1", "b = '"+r.FormValue("b")+"'") }

=== java/sqli-servlet
// want: sast:java/sql-injection
import javax.servlet.http.*;
import java.sql.*;

public class UserServlet extends HttpServlet {
  protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws Exception {
    Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:");
    Statement st = c.createStatement();
    ResultSet rs = st.executeQuery("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + req.getParameter("name") + "'");
  }

=== java/sqli-spring-jdbc-template
// want: sast:java/sql-injection
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;

@RestController
public class UserController {
  private final JdbcTemplate jdbcTemplate;
  public UserController(JdbcTemplate t) { this.jdbcTemplate = t; }

  @GetMapping("/users")
  public Object users(@RequestParam String name) {
    return jdbcTemplate.queryForList("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = '" + name + "'");
  }
}

=== java/safe-prepared-statement

import javax.servlet.http.*;
import java.sql.*;

public class S extends HttpServlet {
  protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws Exception {
    Connection c = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:");

=== java/safe-regex-guard
// want: none
import javax.servlet.http.*;
import java.sql.*;

public class S extends HttpServlet {
  protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws Exception {
    Statement st = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:").createStatement();
    String col = req.getParameter("col");
    if (!col.matches("[a-z_]+")) { return; }
    st.executeQuery("SELECT " + col + " FROM t");
  }
}

=== java/trust-boundary-session
// want: sast:java/trust-boundary
import javax.servlet.http.*;
import java.sql.*;

public class S extends HttpServlet {
  protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest req, HttpServletResponse resp) throws Exception {
    req.getSession().setAttribute("n", req.getParameter("n"));
    Statement st = DriverManager.getConnection("jdbc:h2:mem:").createStatement();
    st.executeQuery("SELECT '" + req.getSession().getAttribute("n") + "'");
  }
}

=== java/zip-slip
// want: sast:java/path-traversal
import java.io.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
public class Unzip {
  void run(ZipInputStream zis, File dest) throws Exception {
    ZipEntry entry;
    while ((entry = zis.getNextEntry()) != null) {
      File out = new File(dest, entry.getName());
      try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(out)) { zis.transferTo(fos); }
    }
  }
}

=== java/safe-zip-canonical-check
// want: none
import java.io.*;
import java.util.zip.*;
public class Unzip {
  void run(ZipInputStream zis, File dest) throws Exception {
    ZipEntry entry;
    while ((entry = zis.getNextEntry()) != null) {
      File out = new File(dest, entry.getName());
      if (!out.getCanonicalPath().startsWith(dest.getCanonicalPath() + File.separator)) {
        throw new IOException("entry escapes the target directory");
      }
      try (FileOutputStream fos = new FileOutputStream(out)) { zis.transferTo(fos); }
    }
  }
}

=== go/zip-zip-slip
// want: sast:go/path-traversal
package main

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
)

func Unzip(r *zip.Reader, dest string) error {
	for _, f := range r.File {
		p := filepath.Join(dest, f.Name)
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

=== go/zip-safe-prefix
// want: none
package main

import (
	"archive/zip"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func Unzip(r *zip.Reader, dest string) error {
	for _, f := range r.File {
		p := filepath.Join(dest, f.Name)
		if !strings.HasPrefix(p, filepath.Clean(dest)+string(os.PathSeparator)) {
			continue
		}
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(p), 0o755); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

=== js/prototype-pollution-recursive-merge
// want: sast:js/prototype-pollution
function merge(target, source) {
  for (const key in source) {
    if (typeof source[key] === 'object') merge(target[key], source[key]);
    else target[key] = source[key];
  }
  return target;
}
app.post('/s', (req, res) => res.json(merge({}, req.body)));

=== go/insecure-random-token
// want: sast:go/insecure-random
package main

import "math/rand"

func newAPIToken() string {
	const letters = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
	b := make([]byte, 32)
	for i := range b {
		b[i] = letters[rand.Intn(len(letters))]
	}
	return string(b)
}

=== ts/sqli-sequelize-template-literal
// want: sast:js/sql-injection
import { type Request, type Response, type NextFunction } from 'express'
export function search () {
  return (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
    let criteria: any = req.query.q === 'undefined' ? '' : req.query.q ?? ''
    criteria = (criteria.length <= 200) ? criteria : criteria.substring(0, 200)
    models.sequelize.query(`SELECT * FROM Products WHERE name LIKE '%${criteria}%'`)
  }
}

=== ts/weak-redirect-allowlist
// want: sast:js/weak-allowlist
export const isRedirectAllowed = (url: string) => {
  let allowed = false
  for (const allowedUrl of redirectAllowlist) {
    allowed = allowed || url.includes(allowedUrl)
  }
  return allowed
}
